web.title: next.config.js: optimizePackageImports | Next.js
web.description: Some packages can export hundreds or thousands of modules, which can cause performance issues in development and production. Adding a package to experimental.optimizePackageImports will only load the modules you are actually using, while still giving you the convenience of writing import statements with many named exports.
